note: Language-independent v3 vectors. invalid_structural is refused by raw schema; invalid_semantic passes raw schema but violates normative admission. selection/agreement/repetition/traces/relations/settlement are context-dependent semantics over claims. Records are claims: no vector establishes producer truth, authorization, enforcement, durability, lineage warrant or actor custody. No runtime qualification.
